Class ParamGroup

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.params.ParamGroup
public final class ParamGroup extends Object
Declares the params of one group. The group name is the file name: group cameras reads params/cameras.json. Get one from Params.group(String). 
private static final ParamGroup CAMERAS = Params.group("cameras");
public static final DoubleParam RESEND_SECONDS =
        CAMERAS.number("settingsResendPeriodSeconds", 2.0, "s", 0.5, 30);
